items.name: kinetik-core
items.title: kinetik core
items.description: Motion tokens (durations, easings, springs) and hooks (useReducedMotion, useInView, cn…).

items.name: canvas-3d-shell
items.title: 3D Canvas Shell
items.description: A production-ready React Three Fiber canvas: clamped DPR, pauses off-screen and in background tabs, reduced-motion aware, lazy-loadable.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: 3D Tilt Card
items.description: The card rotates in 3D toward the pointer on soft springs, with a moving specular glare. Children can pop out with translateZ.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: Light pulses travel along curved connectors between any two elements — the go-to integrations / data-flow diagram.

items.name: text-gradient-animated
items.title: Animated Gradient Text
items.description: A looping multi-stop gradient flows through the letters. Zero JavaScript.

items.name: bg-gradient-mesh
items.title: Animated Mesh Gradient
items.description: Three radial color fields whose anchor points wander via animated @property percentages — a buttery mesh gradient in pure CSS.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: A shared-layout indicator (pill or underline) glides between tabs while panels slide in the direction of travel.

items.name: bg-aurora
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: Three heavily blurred color blobs drift on out-of-phase loops behind your hero. Pure CSS, theme-friendly.

items.name: auto-animate-list
items.title: Auto-Animate List
items.description: Add, remove and shuffle items and everything animates: entries pop in, exits blur out, siblings slide into the gap.

items.name: chart-bar-grow
items.title: Bar Chart Grow
items.description: Bars spring up from the baseline in a left-to-right wave when the chart scrolls into view; hover reveals values.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Apple-style bento layout where each tile's visual lifts and a CTA slides in on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: text-blur-in
items.title: Blur In Text
items.description: Words (or characters) fade up while un-blurring, staggered — the soft, Apple-keynote style entrance.

items.name: button-border-beam
items.title: Border Beam Button
items.description: A comet of light orbits the button's border with a soft glow trail — powered by an animated @property conic gradient.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Clipboard icon pops into a self-drawing checkmark, then returns. Tiny, but it's on every docs site.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Cursor Spotlight
items.description: A soft radial light follows the pointer across a section — fades in on enter, out on leave.

items.name: carousel-drag
items.title: Drag Carousel
items.description: Flick-able carousel with velocity-projected snapping, scaled neighbours, morphing pagination dots and button/keyboard controls.

items.name: drawer-draggable
items.title: Draggable Drawer
items.description: Bottom sheet that follows your finger, rubber-bands upward and dismisses on distance or flick velocity — Vaul-style.

items.name: checkbox-draw
items.title: Drawn Checkbox
items.description: The checkmark draws itself with a stroke-dashoffset transition; optional strike-through sweeps across the label.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A black pill that morphs between sizes — idle, incoming call, now playing, timer — with Apple's slightly bouncy spring.

items.name: error-shake
items.title: Error Shake
items.description: The macOS login 'no' — a damped horizontal shake triggered by any changing value. Pair with color and text for accessibility.

items.name: expandable-card
items.title: Expandable Card
items.description: List rows morph into a full dialog: image, title and subtitle fly into place with shared layout animations.

items.name: bg-noise
items.title: Film Grain
items.description: An SVG feTurbulence grain overlay that jitters in steps like film — instantly makes flat gradients feel tactile and kills banding.

items.name: input-floating-label
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: Material-style floating label driven entirely by CSS (:focus and :placeholder-shown) with a center-out focus underline.

items.name: form-stepper
items.title: Form Stepper
items.description: Multi-step form where steps slide in the direction of travel, connectors fill as you progress, and completed steps morph into checks.

items.name: bg-grid-dots
items.title: Grid & Dot Pattern
items.description: Dot or line grid backgrounds with a radial vignette mask and optional slow pan — the dev-tool aesthetic.

items.name: button-hold-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: Destructive actions require a press-and-hold: a fill wipes across the button and reverses smoothly if released early.

items.name: horizontal-scroll-section
items.title: Horizontal Scroll Section
items.description: Vertical scrolling slides a pinned track sideways — the classic portfolio / case-study gallery.

items.name: image-reveal-mask
items.title: Image Reveal Mask
items.description: Images wipe in with a clip-path curtain (up, left, center-out) while the photo settles from 1.25× zoom — editorial gallery feel.

items.name: stat-counter-grid
items.title: KPI Stat Grid
items.description: Dashboard KPI cards that stagger in, tick up their numbers, draw sparklines and badge the delta — all on first view.

items.name: like-burst
items.title: Like Burst
items.description: Twitter-style heart: squash-and-pop, an expanding ring, a confetti of particles and a rolling counter.

items.name: chart-line-draw
items.title: Line Chart Draw
items.description: A smooth bezier line draws itself on view, the gradient area fades in after, and hover springs a marker with a tooltip.

items.name: button-magnetic
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: The button leans toward the cursor on a bouncy spring, its label leaning further for parallax depth. Snaps back on leave.

items.name: dock-magnify
items.title: Magnifying Dock
items.description: The macOS Dock: icons swell based on cursor distance with springy, interruptible physics and hover labels.

items.name: text-highlighter
items.title: Marker Highlight
items.description: A highlighter-pen stroke or underline draws behind key phrases when they come into view. Wraps across lines.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Seamless infinite marquee for logos and testimonials: horizontal or vertical, reverse, edge fade, pause on hover and an optional pause button.

items.name: bg-meteors
items.title: Meteor Shower
items.description: Shooting stars streak diagonally across a card or hero with randomized timing — deterministic so SSR matches.

items.name: menu-toggle-morph
items.title: Morphing Menu
items.description: Hamburger morphs to an X while a full-screen menu circle-wipes open from the button and links rise from masks in sequence.

items.name: motion-provider
items.title: Motion Provider
items.description: One provider for the whole app: default spring from tokens, reduced-motion wiring and LazyMotion feature loading.

items.name: dialog-animated
items.title: Native Animated Dialog
items.description: A real <dialog> with enter and exit animations in pure CSS (@starting-style + allow-discrete), blurred backdrop and click-outside.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts up to a value when it scrolls into view, with locale-aware formatting, decimals, prefix and suffix.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code input: digits pop into cells, a caret blinks in the active cell, wrong codes shake and clear, right codes turn green.

items.name: parallax-layer
items.title: Parallax Layer
items.description: Wrap anything to give it its own scroll speed. Stack several with different speeds for collage-style depth.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password Strength
items.description: A segmented meter that springs and recolors as rules are met, with a live checklist whose checks pop in.

items.name: button-press
items.title: Press Button
items.description: The foundation button: 2px hover lift, 0.97 press squash, layered shadow and a crisp focus ring. CSS only.

items.name: progress-bar-animated
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Determinate (springy expo-out fill, optional moving stripes) and indeterminate progress, colored with currentColor.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: Progress Ring
items.description: Circular progress whose arc and centered percentage spring smoothly to every new value — interruptible mid-flight.

items.name: transition-slide-stack
items.title: Push / Pop Stack
items.description: Native-feeling navigation stack for the web: new screens slide over while the previous one parallaxes 30% and dims.

items.name: reorder-list
items.title: Reorder List
items.description: Drag a handle to reorder; siblings spring out of the way. Up/down buttons give a keyboard-accessible alternative.

items.name: text-rotate
items.title: Rotating Word
items.description: A word inside a sentence rolls to the next option while its container smoothly resizes to fit — no layout jump.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Characters decode from random glyphs into the final string — on mount, on hover/focus, or both. Great for nav links and techy headlines.

items.name: text-scroll-highlight
items.title: Scroll Highlight Text
items.description: Words light up one by one, scrubbed to scroll position — the 'read along' manifesto paragraph.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: Reading-progress bar or ring linked to scroll with CSS scroll timelines (zero JS on modern browsers) and a passive-listener fallback.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Six reveal variants (fade-up, scale, blur, slide-left/right, fade) scrubbed by native CSS scroll-driven animations, with an IntersectionObserver fallback.

items.name: vt-shared-element
items.title: Shared Element (View Transitions)
items.description: A card's image and title morph into a detail view using the native View Transitions API — the web's answer to iOS hero transitions.

items.name: button-shimmer
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A glossy light sweep crosses the CTA every few seconds, pulling the eye without being noisy.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A light band sweeps across text — the universal 'AI is working' / loading label. Inherits your text color.

items.name: skeleton-shimmer
items.title: Skeleton Shimmer
items.description: Theme-aware skeleton blocks with a soft sweeping highlight. Shape them with Tailwind classes to match your layout.

items.name: navbar-hide-on-scroll
items.title: Smart Navbar
items.description: Full-width bar that morphs into a floating glass pill after scrolling, hides on scroll-down and reappears on scroll-up.

items.name: accordion-smooth
items.title: Smooth Accordion
items.description: Height-auto accordion with asymmetric easing (slow open, quick close) and a rotating plus icon.

items.name: smooth-scroll
items.title: Smooth Scroll (Lenis)
items.description: Lenis provider with GSAP ticker sync, anchor links, a useLenis() hook and an optional contained mode for scrolling a panel.

items.name: spinner-set
items.title: Spinner Set
items.description: Eight pure-CSS loaders — ring, dots, bars, orbit, pulse, wave, morphing square, bounce — that inherit currentColor.

items.name: text-split-reveal
items.title: Split Text Reveal
items.description: Lines, words or characters slide up from a mask as the headline enters the viewport — the signature move of award-winning editorial sites.

items.name: card-spotlight-border
items.title: Spotlight Border Cards
items.description: Card borders light up near the cursor, and the glow flows continuously across neighbouring cards in the grid.

items.name: toggle-switch
items.title: Spring Switch
items.description: iOS-feel switch: the thumb springs across with layout animation and stretches while pressed.

items.name: tooltip-animated
items.title: Spring Tooltip
items.description: Tooltips that spring from their anchor (origin-aware), with hover delay, instant on keyboard focus and a quick exit.

items.name: button-stateful
items.title: Stateful Button
items.description: Idle → spinner → success/error in one element. Width morphs between states with a spring; errors shake.

items.name: sticky-stack-cards
items.title: Sticky Stacking Cards
items.description: Cards pin as you scroll and stack on top of each other; the ones underneath shrink and dim for depth.

items.name: success-check
items.title: Success / Error Mark
items.description: The circle draws, the check (or cross) strokes in, then the whole mark pops — the moment-of-completion signature.

items.name: svg-path-draw
items.title: SVG Path Draw
items.description: Every stroke inside an SVG draws itself — once on view, or scrubbed with scroll — with GSAP DrawSVG. Illustrations, signatures, diagrams.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle + Circle Reveal
items.description: Sun morphs into a moon with springs, and the new theme expands from the button as a circle using the View Transitions API.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: Sonner-style stacked toasts: they pile up with depth, fan out on hover/focus and swipe away to the right.

items.name: text-typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types, holds, deletes and cycles through a list of phrases with a blinking caret.

items.name: hero-split-text
items.title: Hero — Split Text + Aurora
items.description: Landing hero: border-beam announcement pill, words rising from masks, blur-in subhead, shimmer CTA over a grainy aurora.

items.name: cta-spotlight
items.title: CTA — Spotlight & Meteors
items.description: Closing call-to-action panel with a cursor spotlight, meteor shower, animated gradient word and a magnetic button.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ Section
items.description: Two-column FAQ: highlighted heading on the left, smooth height-auto accordion on the right.

items.name: features-bento
items.title: Features — Animated Bento
items.description: Feature section with a bento grid whose tiles each carry a live micro-animation: beams, tickers, shimmer.

items.name: social-proof-marquee
items.title: Logo Cloud + Testimonial Wall
items.description: Logo marquee with a pause control, then two opposite-direction testimonial marquees with faded edges.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing — Period Toggle
items.description: Three-tier pricing with a sliding Monthly/Yearly toggle; prices roll vertically to the new value and the savings badge lights up.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth — Magic Code Sign-in
items.description: Email → OTP → success in one morphing card: stateful button, shaking OTP on wrong codes, animated success mark.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell
items.description: Collapsible spring sidebar with a gliding active indicator, period tabs, KPI tickers with sparklines and a self-drawing chart.

items.name: checkout-steps
items.title: Checkout — Stepper + Confetti
items.description: Shipping → payment → review stepper beside an order summary, ending in a drawn success mark and a confetti burst.

items.name: not-found-playful
items.title: 404 — Drifting Orb
items.description: A playful 404: the zero floats as a glowing orb, the message decodes itself, and the CTA is magnetic.

items.name: flow-paywall
items.title: Paywall
items.description: Subscription paywall: features stagger in, plan cards share a sliding selection ring, trial switch springs, and the CTA shimmers into a success state.

items.name: flow-auth
items.title: Phone Sign-in
items.description: Phone number → SMS code → verified, with a custom keypad, popping digits, a shake on wrong codes and a drawn success check.

items.name: flow-onboarding
items.title: Onboarding Pager
items.description: Swipeable 3-page onboarding: pages slide with a spring, hero images parallax and settle, the dot indicator stretches, and the CTA morphs into “Get started”.

items.name: flow-habit-check-in
items.title: Habit Check-in
items.description: Daily habit tracker: checking a habit bursts particles, fills the streak ring, and completing all of them extends the 🔥 streak with a celebration toast.

items.name: flow-checkout
items.title: Swipe-to-Pay Checkout
items.description: Mobile bag with rolling quantity stepper and a swipe-to-pay slider that fills green, snaps home if released early, and lands on a spinning success badge.

items.name: flow-profile-settings
items.title: Profile & Settings
items.description: iOS-style profile: the avatar shrinks and the large title hands off to a compact blurred header as you scroll; spring toggles with haptics.
